title: Mt.St. Helens
imageAlt: A view of Mt. St. Helens from Lahar Viewpoint.
text: To close out the summer, we went camping just south of Mt. St. Helens this Labor Day weekend. We had a great time seeing the volcano up close, and exploring the lava canyon.

title: Patterson Lake Cabins
imageAlt: Cabins beyond a lawn, beach with kayaks in the foreground.
text: We went back to Sun Mountain lodge in August. The fire smoke was a bit of a damper, but did provide great lighting and sunsets.

title: New Plant
imageAlt: A red pearled succulent plant on a bed of rocks in front of a window.
text: We went backpacking in the North Cascades and found this little guy on a rock field. Watering it and seeing the new sprouts has added an extra spark of excitement to my morning routine.

title: Columbia River Sunset
imageAlt: A view of the Columbia River from Kalama, WA with a Mississippi Style steam boat off to the side.
text: We visited the McMenamins in Kalama, WA in an ongoing effort to get as many stamps in my McMenamins passport as possible. The food was great, but the view of sunset over the Columbia River was even better.

title: Annual Lantern Festival
imageAlt: A sky full of lanterns floating into the night sky, over a crowd of people in the center of a race track.
text: Our annual tradition of going to the Night Lights Lantern Festival in Idaho was as magical as ever.

title: Fluid Architecture
imageAlt: A view of a German building with fluid architecture.
text: While I love living the states, going back to Germany to visit family is always a treat. Especially when I see architecture like this, it just feels like they're living in a fairytale.

title: Russell Cave
imageAlt: A view of a stream flowing into a cave in the middle of a forest.
text: While visiting family in Tennessee, we did a day trip into Alabama and saw this beautiful cave. We learned the cave is believed to have been first used over 12,000 years ago by Native Americans.

title: Patterson Lake Cabins
imageAlt: Cabins covered in snow seen from the surface of a frozen lake
text: My family stayed at the Sun Mountain Lodge cabins at Patterson Lake over the long weekend in January. We spent a wonderful time enjoying the winter wonderland. There wasn't much fresh snow, but the lake was completely frozen over allowing for endless fun on ice.

title: Bean in the Sunshine
imageAlt: My cat bean sitting between the curtains and the sunlit window casting an iconic cat shaped shadow.
text: Bean loves basking in the sunlight, even when there's no birds to watch.

title: Ooey Gooey Mushroom
imageAlt: A closeup of a gooey mushroom in a forest
text: During a recent nature walk, I stumbled upon this funky mushroom.
